RENT AGREEMENT

This Rent Agreement is executed at New Delhi between Shri Ramesh Kumar (Lessor) and Ms. Priya Sharma (Lessee) for the residential premises situated at C-14, Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi.

1. The monthly rent shall be ₹25,000 payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each English calendar month.
2. The Lessee shall pay a security deposit of ₹2,50,000 and the deposit shall be forfeited in full if the Lessee vacates before the lock-in period.
3. A late fee of ₹2,000 per day shall apply for delayed rent after the due date.
4. The Lessor or his agents may enter the premises without prior notice at any time to inspect the property.
5. The Lessor may evict the Lessee for any reason with 48 hours notice.
6. The Lessee waives all rights under the Delhi Rent Control Act and any other tenant protection law.
7. The Lessee shall be responsible for all repairs including structural and major repairs to the premises.
8. No guest shall stay overnight in the premises without the prior written permission of the Lessor.
9. The Lessee shall not approach any government authority with any complaint regarding the premises or this agreement.
10. The agreement shall renew only at the sole discretion of the Lessor with 60 days notice from the Lessee required for renewal.
